Do a transmissive dark calibration on the instrument itself
Place the instrument on its reflective white reference

conditions.instruction: Click the instrument down on its reflective white reference

Place the ambient adapter and cap on the instrument, or place it on the calibration reference
Set the instrument sensor to its calibration position

calibration_setup.document: X-Rite AutoScan Spectrophotometer Operator's Manual, DTP41-500 Rev. O
calibration_setup.quote: Center the designated end of the Color Reflection Reference under the alignment mark.
calibration_setup.text: Insert the instrument's own Color Reflection Reference under the alignment mark and hold the button for three seconds.

instructions.detail: Present the declared external display stimulus and keep it unchanged during the frequency measurement
Prepare the requested strip, then continue
Position the sample or measurement optics, then continue
Set up what the instrument asks for to calibrate, then continue
Do what the instrument asks for to calibrate; it continues by itself
Place the chart on the table
Sight a named fiducial so the table can locate the sheet
The sensor, dial, diffuser or adapter is not where this step needs it. Move it, then continue; the step is tried once more

native_diagnostics.scope: Auxiliary stderr provenance; no scientific setting changes

operator_setup.document: X-Rite AutoScan Spectrophotometer Operator's Manual, DTP41-500 Rev. O
operator_setup.quote: Position the strip so that the group of patches to measure is directly under alignment mark on the cover.
operator_setup.text: Leave a 1.5 in leader, put the patch column under the alignment mark and insert the strip to the rear rollers.

assessment.text: The native route measures reflection. Patch isolation and operator placement still follow the instrument's setup.
